Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.477 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Mohammadpur Khala, District Barabanki.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant.
The applicant is the mother-in-law of the deceased.
The daughter was left by the son of the applicant at my home two days prior and on 20.09.2023, an information was received that the daughter of the informant died by hanging.

4.
Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that apart from the ligature mark, no other injury was visible on the body of the deceased coupled with the fact that there is no allegation against the applicant of causing any mental or physical harassment to the deceased soon before the death in relation to the demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant is 50 years old and has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 30.09.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
